newsitem.title: FINLAND: BANK OF FINLAND NEW MARKKA&TALOUS DUE DEC 11 0930.
newsitem.headline: BANK OF FINLAND NEW MARKKA&TALOUS DUE DEC 11 0930.

text.p: The Bank of Finland will hold a news conference on December 11 at 0930 (0730 GMT) in connection with the release of the 4/1996 issue of its Markka & Talous publication, the central bank said in a statement on Monday.
Bank of Finland governor Sirkka Hamalainen will present the economic prospects outlined in the leading article of the quarterly publication, it said.
